description: A jQuery plugin for image cropping, including functions for selection, dragging, resizing, shading, and event handling.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets a new image source for cropping and reinitializes dimensions.

methods.name: animateTo
methods.description: Animates the cropping selection to specified coordinates.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Updates configuration options for the cropping tool.

methods.name: tellSelect
methods.description: Returns the current selection rectangle coordinates.

methods.name: tellScaled
methods.description: Returns the current scaled coordinates of the selection.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Sets CSS class for the cropping container.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the cropping interface and restores original image.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Activates key support for keyboard navigation.
